imageryRule: Stock or generated imagery may be used after human approval, documented rights, contextual and representation review, useful alternative text, and a clear rule against presenting a synthetic person as documentary evidence. Real-person likenesses require consent and an approved use.
iconRule: Use text-first controls and never rely on a symbol alone. Any visual symbol must have a clear text label and pass accessibility review.
protectedLogoRule: The package DHS logo is a locked reference. Do not modify, regenerate, recolor, crop, or replace the application logo.
